parts.name: AI classification + Router
parts.status: Prepared - direct Ask AI -> Router candidate; local graph checks only, live import/execution PENDING
parts.importable_artifact_note: DIRECT candidate template (export wrapper templateVersion 2.0.0, serialization_version {2,0,0}, title 'Part 2 - Direct AI Router (regex validation)'). Flow: Ticket Created -> Ask AI (two-line text output: category line + Justification line) -> Router with EXACTLY 3 named routes (Bug/Feature/Enhancement), matched by JSONata $match regex on the AI output; NO Execute Code steps. Bug path: severity high + a native if_else JSONata $match regex title check (^\[BUG\] .{5,120}$) + internal invalid-title comment. Feature/Enhancement: severity medium. Internal classification-justification comment on each accepted path. All comments internal; all object/id targeting is dynamic $get('ticket_created_1','output').id (no hardcoded DON). Malformed AI output matches no route and performs no branch action - a Completed run with no route taken is NOT success; inspect the actual AI output and route in the Runs tab. Build/verify notes are in part2-ai-classify-router/build.md. LOCALLY structure-validated only (tests/part2/test_direct_router_template.py: Ask AI wired directly to Router, EXACTLY 3 routes with matching ports, no invoke_code/validator references, reachable/acyclic, all $get refs resolve, Bug=high and the other two update_ticket steps=medium, severity enum lowercase, single if_else with true/false ports, internal comments, no hardcoded DON, plus Python equivalents of the routing/Bug-title regex samples). A LIVE sandbox import, dynamic Router ports, and JSONata regex evaluation are UNVERIFIED - this is NOT a proven pass; do not call it import-ready. The Bug title format (^\[BUG\] .{5,120}$) is a stated lab convention, not an assessment requirement.
